Overview

Azure cloud service for providing cloud storage. It's a fully managed service offering different types of data storage: object, file, disk, queue and table.

  • Disks: are block level storage that can be used together with Azure virtual machines.
  • Blob: Store images, documents and other types of media.

Azure Blob Storage

Object storage solution for the cloud. unstructured data

interact with objects using http/https through the azure powershell, azure cli, Azure Storage Rest API or one of the SDK. It's also possible to usse sftp or nfs

Supports Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
